name: writing-ai-paper
description: Writing AI Conference Papers — a beginner's handbook by hzwer (Zhewei Huang) and DingXiaoH (Xiaohan Ding), packaged as an invocable skill. Guidance on finding the core idea, building the framework, writing the introduction/related work, improving readability and defensibility, last-hours checklists, common negative review comments, and which research ideas tend not to work.

author.name: hzwer (Zhewei Huang) and DingXiaoH (Xiaohan Ding); skill packaging
